summary.text:
**Clarifying support types**

I'm considering the support structure involved here. It seems to be a support underneath the shaft instead of a concentric bearing. Even though it’s called a bearing, the cylinder is actually lower than the axle, supporting a tangent on top. I find this distinction interesting, as it highlights different types of structural support and their functions. It’s always fascinating to understand these mechanics better!
